A linear regulator controls a series pas: A linear regulator controls a series pass element. Its input must remain high enough for the desired output plus the device’s required dropout headroom. A linear regulator is a DC-to-DC control: A linear regulator is a DC-to-DC control stage. It can follow a transformer supply, a battery, or a switching converter. A perfectly constant voltage D has avera: A perfectly constant voltage D has average D and RMS magnitude |D|.
